question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Imbroglio
solution:
The correct answer is: **Agreement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Imbroglio"** refers to a complicated or confused situation, often involving conflict or misunderstanding. (उलझन या विवाद)

 
 
• **Example:** The diplomatic imbroglio between the two nations lasted for several months.
 
 
 
• **"Agreement"** is the opposite of imbroglio, as it signifies harmony, mutual understanding, or a consensus between parties. (समझौता या सहमति)
 
 
• **Example:** The two companies reached an agreement to collaborate on the new project.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **"Imbroglio"** is **"Agreement"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Agreement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Entanglement** (उलझाव): A complicated or intertwined situation or relationship.

 
 
• **Example:** His entanglement in legal disputes made his life stressful.
 
 
 
• **Complication** (जटिलता): A situation that is complex or difficult to resolve.
 
 
• **Example:** The sudden complication in the surgery required immediate attention.
 
 
 
• **Dispute** (विवाद): A disagreement or argument between parties.
 
 
• **Example:** The land dispute between the neighbors escalated into a legal battle.
